$comment: Maude Cloud pricing — Cloud Phase 8, seeded from cloud-phase-0-economics-and-architecture.md §3.
PROPOSAL, NOT SIGNED OFF. Phase 0 §3 says the final numbers are the owner's call, locked
at Phase 8's start. These objects exist in the Stripe SANDBOX account so the billing code
has something real to run against; changing a number here means creating a NEW price in
Stripe (prices are immutable once created) and updating the id, never editing the amount.
The `live` ids are deliberately null. Nothing in live mode has been created, and the code
that reads this must refuse to operate in live mode until they are filled in — a placeholder
id that silently falls back to the sandbox is how a real customer gets charged nothing, or
how a test charge lands on a real card.
Pricing is PER PROJECT and never per seat: the invite is the product's core action
(DDR-193 §5/§6), so charging for it would tax the thing the product is for.
